question: If (a + b + c) = 20, and a² + b² + c² = 152, find the value of a³ + b³ + c³ - 3abc.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Direct formula: a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc = 1/2 × (a + b + c) × [3(a² + b² + c²) − (a + b + c)²]

⇒ 1/2 × 20 × [3 × 152 − 20²]

⇒ 10 × [456 − 400]

⇒ 10 × 56 = 560

**∴ The correct answer is 560.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

(a + b + c) = 20

a² + b² + c² = 152

**Formula Used:**

(a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2(ab + bc + ca)

a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc = (a + b + c)[a² + b² + c² − (ab + bc + ca)]

**Calculations:**

⇒ (20)² = 152 + 2(ab + bc + ca)

⇒ 400 = 152 + 2(ab + bc + ca)

⇒ 2(ab + bc + ca) = 400 − 152

⇒ 2(ab + bc + ca) = 248

⇒ (ab + bc + ca) = 248 ÷ 2 = 124

Now, substituting the values into the second identity:

⇒ a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc = 20 × (152 − 124)

⇒ a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc = 20 × 28

⇒ a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc = 560

**∴ The correct answer is 560.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cubic Identity Condition

If a + b + c = 0, then the primary identity simplifies directly to a³ + b³ + c³ = 3abc.

Alternative Cubic Form

a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc = 1/2 × (a + b + c)[(a − b)² + (b − c)² + (c − a)²]

Standard Binomial Cubes

(a + b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab(a + b) and (a − b)³ = a³ − b³ − 3ab(a − b)
